description:
Focus Timer helps you get real work done using the Pomodoro Technique: focus hard for 25 minutes, take a short break, and repeat. After four sessions you've earned a long break.

A calm animated ring shows exactly how much time is left, and the whole app gently changes colour so you always know whether it's time to work or time to rest. When a phase ends you'll get a chime and a notification — even if you've switched to another app, because Focus Timer keeps perfect time in the background.

Make it yours by adjusting every length, turning on auto-start, and watching your daily sessions, focus minutes and streak grow in the built-in stats.
whatsNew: All-new design with a smooth progress ring, seven-day chart, day streaks and auto-start.
